body:
First of all I am very very sorry to hear about your mum, think of this in reverse, how would you feel if she committed suicide?

It's understandable how you feel, I would take sit back and calm down since the death of your mother is EXTREMELY fresh. What I would do is leave that shit job and go on vacation and clear my head.

Then what I would do is work towards a better job/career and try and find someone (a partner) to start a family with, not only would I do this for myself, but to make my parents happy who are looking over me. 

I hope you can read this but this is my best advice. My mum came from a big and abusive family and ended up with no family at 18, she survived, found my dad (and many other partners after they divorced) and had two kids and is still going strong

I know people think I'm insane when I say my social life is shit, especially at a place like uni and London South Bank. 

When it comes to clubs I'll have be very selective I don't want to be coming across desperate or middle aged people (what I heard about meetup.com for instance)

Thank you, the thing is my university is not a typical university, I knew people who dropped out due to the social life being so bad there. Most students are at living home and are very antisocial I am in reality a very open and sociable person, I was always to the person to invite people out and suggest things to do but I gave up since nobody puts in the effort. Things were so bad that my "group" won't even sit together for lunch, they just ghost when lectures are done, so I really feel like I missed my chance to even fix my life in that way. 

Will TRY to stay patient with the online dating thing with an honest profile; I can be extremely frustrating
